title: Microsoft Debuts New Homegrown AI Chip, Plans to Deploy Multiple Gigawatts Next Year
text:
Microsoft on Monday announced the latest generation of its homegrown AI chips, dubbed the Maia 300, and said it plans to set up “multi-gigawatt deployments” of the chip starting next year.
